breaking.change: Cook modules reject dynamic import and await before execution. Source outputs reject undefined, functions, symbols, BigInt, promises, class instances, sparse arrays, hidden/accessor properties and cycles instead of silently dropping or coercing them through JSON.stringify.
breaking.fix: Use synchronous static imports and explicit plain data. Omit optional fields rather than setting undefined; return numeric typed arrays or dense arrays. Type-only imports are erased before the executable dependency graph is collected.
